"""FuzzExecutor frame conversion and execution against an injected transport."""
from HTTP3_Just_Send import HttpClient
from modules.clock import Clock
from modules.events import HeadersReceived, DataReceived, ConnectionTerminated, SendError
from modules.byte_program import (leaf, merge, fingerprint, size, concat)


def encoded_action(at, stream, kind, data, end=False):
    """One receipt entry: time, stream, kind, content and the end marker."""
    parts = [leaf(at.to_bytes(8, 'big')), leaf(stream.to_bytes(4, 'big')),
             leaf(kind.encode('ascii'))]
    if kind in ('H', 'h'):
        parts.append(leaf(len(data).to_bytes(8, 'big')))
        for name, value in data:
            parts.append(leaf(size(name).to_bytes(8, 'big')))
            parts.append(name)
            parts.append(leaf(size(value).to_bytes(8, 'big')))
            parts.append(value)
    else:
        parts.append(leaf(size(data).to_bytes(8, 'big')))
        parts.append(data)
    parts.append(leaf(bytes([1 if end else 0])))
    result = parts[0]
    for part in parts[1:]:
        result = merge(result, part)
    return result


class OfflineTransport(object):
    """Records the emitted client actions per case."""

    def __init__(self, clock, count):
        self.clock = clock
        self.next_stream = 0
        self.ended = set()
        self.sent = [None] * count
        self.frames = [0] * count
        self.request_frames = [0] * count
        self.payload_bytes = [0] * count
        self.client = None

    def get_next_available_stream_id(self):
        stream = self.next_stream
        self.next_stream += 4
        return stream

    def record(self, stream_id, kind, data, end_stream=False):
        if stream_id in self.ended:
            raise SendError('frame after request end')
        index = stream_id // 4
        action = encoded_action(self.clock.now, stream_id, kind, data, end_stream)
        self.sent[index] = merge(self.sent[index], action)
        self.frames[index] += 1
        if kind in ('H', 'D'):
            self.request_frames[index] += 1
        if kind == 'H':
            self.payload_bytes[index] += sum(size(name) + size(value) for name, value in data)
        else:
            self.payload_bytes[index] += size(data)
        if end_stream:
            self.ended.add(stream_id)

    def send_headers(self, stream_id, headers, end_stream):
        self.record(stream_id, 'H', headers, end_stream)

    def send_data(self, stream_id, data, end_stream):
        self.record(stream_id, 'D', data, end_stream)

    def send_datagram(self, stream_id, data):
        self.record(stream_id, 'G', data)

    def dispatch(self, record):
        if record['kind'] == 'close':
            self.client.quic_event_received(ConnectionTerminated())
        elif record['kind'] == 'headers':
            self.client.quic_event_received(HeadersReceived(record['stream'], record['fields'], record['end']))
        else:
            self.client.quic_event_received(DataReceived(record['stream'], record['data'], record['end']))


class FuzzExecutor(object):
    def __init__(self, context=None, target_ip=None, target_port=None, domain=None):
        self._context = context
        self.target_ip = target_ip
        self.target_port = target_port
        self.domain = domain

    def _convert_single_case_frames(self, frames, case_index):
        """Compile the templates of one case into byte sequences."""
        converted = []
        for index, item in enumerate(frames):
            base = 'case/%d/frame/%d' % (case_index, index)
            kind = item.Type
            if kind == 'headers':
                headers = []
                for pair_index, pair in enumerate(item.data_to_transfered):
                    name = self._context.template(pair[0], '%s/h/%d/n' % (base, pair_index))
                    value = self._context.template(pair[1], '%s/h/%d/v' % (base, pair_index))
                    headers.append((name, value))
                converted.append({'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': headers,
                                  'End_Stream': bool(item.End_Stream)})
            elif kind in ('data', 'datagram'):
                data = self._context.template(item.data_to_transfered, base + '/data')
                converted.append({'Type': kind, 'data_to_transfered': data,
                                  'End_Stream': bool(item.End_Stream)})
            else:
                converted.append({'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': int(item.Time_to_Stop)})
        return converted

    def send_payload(self, llm_output, records, timeout_ms):
        clock = Clock()
        transport = OfflineTransport(clock, len(llm_output))
        client = HttpClient(clock, transport, timeout_ms)
        transport.client = client
        coroutines = []
        for index, (case_name, frames) in enumerate(llm_output.items()):
            payload = self._convert_single_case_frames(frames, index)
            coroutines.append(client.request(payload, index))
        results = clock.run(coroutines, records, transport.dispatch)
        out = []
        for index, result in enumerate(results):
            received = None
            body = None
            response_frames = 0
            for at, event in result.events:
                if isinstance(event, HeadersReceived):
                    encoded = encoded_action(at, result.stream, 'h', event.headers, event.stream_ended)
                else:
                    encoded = encoded_action(at, result.stream, 'd', event.data, event.stream_ended)
                    body = merge(body, event.data)
                received = merge(received, encoded)
                response_frames += 1
            out.append({'name': list(llm_output)[index], 'stream': result.stream,
                        'state': result.terminal, 'at': result.at,
                        'frames': transport.frames[index],
                        'request_frames': transport.request_frames[index],
                        'payload_bytes': transport.payload_bytes[index],
                        'sent': fingerprint(transport.sent[index]),
                        'received': fingerprint(received),
                        'response_frames': response_frames,
                        'response_body': fingerprint(body),
                        'origin_count': 0, 'flags': []})
        return out
